newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil - quietens, prices firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil - quietens, prices firm.

text.p: The continued thinning of Russian high sulphur straight run supply bolstered prices while low sulphur straight run faced a quieter day after the two trades seen on Tuesday.
Prices were unchanged around the $140 cif NWE level.
Dealers said E-4 cargoes were assessed around formula +$3-4 cif NWE with M-100 going around the two means +$3-4 cif.
"The level of Russian exports is dropping so we could see prices firming up," said one trader who added that Russian material in the Med was more plentifully offered.
